component.name: GPS Repair for GoPro
component.summary: Recover degraded GPS so GoPro Quik can add telemetry gauges
Recupere o GPS degradado para o GoPro Quik adicionar os medidores de telemetria
Recupera el GPS degradado para que GoPro Quik pueda añadir los indicadores
修复受损的 GPS 数据，让 GoPro Quik 能够添加遥测仪表

description.p: On mountain bike rides or trails under tree cover, the GPS of action cameras often loses signal. The telemetry recorded inside the video ends up with gaps, poor precision and position jumps, and GoPro Quik refuses to add its telemetry gauges.
This app assesses the GPS recorded in the video, shows its real condition and, after you confirm, rebuilds the track into a new video:

ul.li: Kalman filter with RTS smoother, using position and Doppler speed
Rejection of position jumps and interpolation of gaps
Only the GPS fields change: video, audio and all other metadata stay byte-for-byte identical
Report of what was restored and how, marking each point as corrected or estimated
Available in English, Portuguese, Spanish and Chinese

description.p: Supports cameras that record GPS5 telemetry (HERO5 to HERO10). The original file is never changed. This is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by GoPro, Inc.

screenshot.caption: Restoration in progress, with an abort button
Report of what was restored and how

description.p: First release with a graphical interface: GPS assessment, confirmation, restoration with abort and a detailed report.
